Item.Hint: Enter unit ID or press enter for donor search.

Trigger.Name: WHEN_VALIDATE_ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_var VARCHAR2(1);
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=null; --- This variable is referenced by the library
:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:=null;

 -- The following if statement added by Edwin for ISBT

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id is not null then 

 If Length (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)= 15 then
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 Elsif length (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)= 7 then
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if ltrim(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id);

 :GLOBAL.unit_id:=szUnitId; 
 End if;

 IF :GLOBAL.entry = '1' and length (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)= 7 THEN
 IF :system.cursor_value is null THEN
 return;
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.value := :system.cursor_value;
 :GLOBAL.entry := '2';
 copy(null,:system.cursor_item);
 message('Please re-enter ...',no_acknowledge);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 IF :GLOBAL.value != nvl(:system.cursor_value,'XNULLX') THEN
 :GLOBAL.entry := '1';
 :GLOBAL.value := null;
 copy(null,:system.cursor_item);
 show_error('16000'); 
 END IF;
 SELECT donor_id, coll_date 
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.donor_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 FROM donations
 WHERE unit_id = szUnitId
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.donor_id is null THEN
 show_error('17003');
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 show_error('16070');
 WHEN too_many_rows THEN
 null; --As per Track record # 000152 on 09/06/2001
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 temp_unit number;
 no_days number; 
 szUnitId varchar2(15);
 eRaise Exception;
 v_count NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=NULL;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id is not null then
 
 IF Length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)=15 then --if initial unit id is isbt
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 szUnitId := substr(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,1,13);
 
 if not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,1,5)) then 
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id:=null;
 show_error('16206');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 
 if not number_check(substr(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id:=NULL;
 show_error('16211');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 ELSE -- If codabar
 
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if ltrim(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;

 szUnitId := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;


 if length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)!=7 and :GLOBAL.double_check is null then
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;


 if :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme ='N' then
 if not number_check(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id) then
 show_error('0220');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;


 -- If codabar first entry is correct ask for the second entry

 
 If :global.double_check is null then
 :global.double_check:= :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id:=NULL;
 message('Please Re-enter the unit id for confirmation',no_acknowledge);
 raise eRaise;
 Else
 if Length(:global.double_check)!= Length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id) then
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 
 if :global.double_check!=:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id then
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 END IF; --isbt or codabar

 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id);
 
 --- Once the unit verification is over, now go to the donations table and findout the unit is
 --- exists or not or with multiple collection date.

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_count from donations
 WHERE unit_id = szUnitId AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 If v_count = 0 then 
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('16070');
 check_package_failure;
 Elsif v_count = 1 then 
 SELECT donor_id, coll_date 
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.donor_id, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date
 FROM donations WHERE unit_id = szUnitId AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.donor_id is null THEN
 :global.double_check:=null;
 show_error('17003');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 Else
 null;
 End if;


 ELSE --for null or not null
 if :global.double_check is not null then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;


EXCEPTION 
 when eRaise then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 null; -- message('I do not know why im executing '||sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure; --check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_RES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_RES IS
 temp_val varchar2(20);
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);

 procedure insert_update (locus in varchar2, epitope in varchar2) is
 begin
 update unit_test_results 
 set result_code = epitope,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name,
 insert_date = sysdate,
 insert_user = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 where unit_id = szUnitId
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and test_id = locus;
 IF sql%notfound THEN
 insert into unit_test_results
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id,
 test_id, result_code, program_id,
 insert_date, insert_user)
 values
 (szUnitId, :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date, 
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 locus, epitope, :banner.prog_name,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id);
 END IF;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 
BEGIN
 
 IF Length(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 End if;

 IF :donor_hla_antigens.a1 is not null then
 temp_val := :donor_hla_antigens.a1;
 insert_update('A1',temp_val);
 END IF; 
 IF :donor_hla_antigens.a2 is not null then
 insert_update('A2',:donor_hla_antigens.a2);
 END IF;
 IF :donor_hla_antigens.b1 is not null then
 insert_update('B1',:donor_hla_antigens.b1);
 END IF;
 IF :donor_hla_antigens.b2 is not null then
 insert_update('B2',:donor_hla_antigens.b2);
 END IF; 

EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_UNIT_TEST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_unit_test (scan_unit_id in varchar2,
 man_or_scan in varchar2,
 unit_scheme in varchar2,
 unit_id out varchar2)
is
 start_pos number(1);
 dummy_x varchar2(1);
 temp_unit_scheme varchar2(1);
begin

/*** This is commented by Edwin , because it will never return any value other than 'I' : 05-07-2001

 if nvl(name_in('manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_type'),'C') != 'C' THEN
 show_error('9761');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
*/

 default_value('N','GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme');
 temp_unit_scheme := name_in('global.codabar_unit_scheme'); 
--message('scheme='||temp_unit_scheme||' Length='||length(scan_unit_id));pause;
 if man_or_scan = 'M' then

 if (NVL(length(scan_unit_id), 0) = 7 and temp_unit_scheme in ('N','A'))
 or (NVL(length(scan_unit_id), 0) = 10 and temp_unit_scheme = '8') then
 unit_id := scan_unit_id;
 else
 show_error('6060');
 end if; 
 else
 if temp_unit_scheme in ('A','N') and
 substr(scan_unit_id,1,1) = 'D' and
 substr(scan_unit_id,9,1) = 'D' and
 NVL(length(scan_unit_id), 0) = 9
 then
 unit_id := substr(scan_unit_id,2,NVL(length(scan_unit_id), 0)-2);
 elsif temp_unit_scheme in ('A','N') and
 ltrim(scan_unit_id,'0987654321') is null
 then
 unit_id := scan_unit_id;
 else
 show_error('6060');
 end if;
 end if;

 start_pos := NVL(length(unit_id), 0) - 4;
 --
 -- if translation required and
 -- length = 7 (=> nnnnnnn) then unit_id = XXnnnnn
 -- = 10 (=> RRRnnnnnnn) then unit_id = RRRXXnnnnn
 -- where XX is Testing Srvc prefix and RRR is Red Cross Region #
 --
 -- message('One '|| man_or_scan || ' ' || temp_unit_scheme);pause;

 if temp_unit_scheme in ('A','8')
 then
 if man_or_scan = 'S'
 then
 select
 substr(unit_id,1,start_pos-3)||eye_read_trns||
 substr(unit_id,start_pos)
 into unit_id
 from bar_code_prefixes
 where machine_code = substr(unit_id,start_pos-2,2);
 end if;
 if man_or_scan = 'M'
 then
 select max('x') into dummy_x
 from bar_code_prefixes
 where eye_read_trns = substr(unit_id,start_pos-2,2)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 if dummy_x is null
 then
 show_error('0222');
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 if (temp_unit_scheme = 'N' and
 ltrim(substr(unit_id,start_pos-2,2),'0987654321') is not null)
 then
 show_error('0220');
 end if;
 --
 if ltrim(substr(unit_id,start_pos),'0987654321') is not null 
 or ltrim(substr(unit_id,1,start_pos-3),'0987654321') is not null
 then
 show_error('0221');
 end if;

 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));

 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
